_comment: Your own changes to skills, applied over the game data when the server starts (restart after editing). Key: skill id (the Grimoire's skill search shows ids). All fields are optional: damageMultiplier scales damage (or healing) at every rank; ranks sets exact numbers for single ranks, numbered as in game (1 = the first rank), with initial and base as in the skill formula ceil(base + initial x (1 + sqrt(ability / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor))); cooldown (seconds), energy and castTime set every rank. name is only a label for you. The PvP version of a skill gets the same changes. Entries starting with _ are ignored, so remove the _ to switch an example on. Damage over time (Rupture's bleed, poisons, burns) is the skill's status effect, set with dotMultiplier (scales every rank's per-tick amount), dotRanks (exact amount and base for single ranks: per tick = ceil(base + amount x (1 + sqrt(ability / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor)))), dotDuration (seconds) and dotTick (seconds between ticks; most tick every 5). The same status-effect fields also work under effect… names (effectMultiplier, effectRanks, effectDuration) for buffs and debuffs that aren't damage over time, e.g. how much skill evasion Bless gives. castWithWeaponDelay: true makes the cast take the weapon's attack delay (with haste) on top of its own cast time, landing at its end; the client's casting circle shows the same (client patch P18, whose skill list must match). damageAsDot turns a skill's hit into damage over time with the same total: {"effect": a damage-over-time status effect id for the icon, "ticks": 5, "seconds": 10}; the hit's damage (same formula, resists applied) is split into equal ticks, the first on the hit. weaponDelayOffset (seconds, with castWithWeaponDelay): added to the weapon-delay cast time, e.g. -0.5 lands it half a second sooner; the casting circle follows (sent to the client mod). evasionPercent: how much of a monster's evasion counts against the skill (50 = half, 100 = as the game has it); minLandChance: the lowest percent chance it lands on a monster, whatever its evasion (0 = no floor). Both only change skills on monsters, not on players. Edit them with ch-tool.cmd (Crits & skills tab).

214.name: Rupture (owner, 2026-10-16: bleed ticks at full strength as on live, 23.23 + 11.85 x (1 + sqrt(Strength/10) + sqrt(Melee Combat/100)) at rank 50, every second, 10 ticks: the first on the hit (owner's rule 2026-10-16), then at 1-9 s (9.5 so the last lands before it ends); the game's own 14 s cooldown)

_223.name: Bless (all skill evasions; rank 50 gives ceil(base + amount x (1 + sqrt(Nature Magic / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor)))). Remove the _ to use

8061.name: Pounce (the spider pets' skill; owner's rule 2026-10-18: its damage, same formula with Spider Taming, comes as poison over 10 s in 5 equal ticks, the first on the pounce, under Snakebite's poison icon)

192.name: Shadowstrike (set evasionPercent / minLandChance in the tool)
